Name: More Tapioca
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[b][color=#f1c232][size=5][font=Courier New][i]UPDATE on 10/30/2026[/i][/font][/size][/color]
[/b][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Shared ingredients, including tapioca starch, brown sugar syrup, and tapioca pearls, have moved to [color=#f1c232]Yuzu More Ingredients[/color].
Please install Yuzu More Ingredients and [color=#ffd966]Yuzu More Craftables[/color], along with their requirements, when updating. More Tapioca contains the drinks and their recipes. You don’t need to install the other More food mods.
[color=#e69138]Remove the old More Tapioca folder before installing the updated version to avoid leaving outdated files behind.[/color][/b][/font][/size]



[b][color=#f4cccc][size=5][font=Courier New]How to Make Tapioca Pearls[/font][/size][/color][/b]

[font=Courier New][b][size=4]1. [/size][i][color=#ffd966][size=5]Tapioca Starch[/size][/color][/i][size=4] — Put Cassava in the Mill to make Tapioca Starch.[/size][/b][/font]

[b][font=Courier New][size=4]2. [/size][i][color=#ffd966][size=5]Secret Woods Spring Water[/size][/color][/i][size=4] — First, craft an Empty Springwater Bottle. You’ll find it under “Other” in the crafting menu. Hold the empty bottle and collect water from any pond or river in the Secret Woods. One empty bottle gives you five bottles of Secret Woods Spring Water.[/size][/font][/b]

[b][font=Courier New][size=4]3. [/size][i][color=#ffd966][size=5]Kuromitsu[/size][/color] [/i][size=4]— Cook Brown Sugar, any Honey, and Secret Woods Spring Water to make this rich brown sugar syrup.[/size][/font][/b]

[size=4][font=Courier New][b]4. Put one Tapioca Starch, one Kuromitsu, and one Secret Woods Spring Water into a Preserves Jar. Seven hours later, you’ll get three chewy tapioca pearls![/b][/font][/size]




[font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color]
[/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Courier New][b][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Download and unzip the file.[/b][/font][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Place the extracted folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/b][/font][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Keep the folder structure as it is.[/b][/font][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Courier New][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Do not move or extract the individual mod folders from their parent folder.[/size][/color][/b][/font]

Downloads.Description:
REMOVE the old folder first.

DO NOT just overwrite when it update.

Version 2.0.0 is completely different from previous versions.
